How Products Ebb And Flow
22 April 2016: Since the global financial crisis, when product trades declined as a result of a sudden pull-back in oil demand, the oil trades (both crude and products) have made a comeback. However, the individual products that are driving the expansion of oil demand are not all growing at the same rate.
